title: The Pale Machine
author: Zephyrine Galloway
blurb: Ivo Almeida, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
